evidence_class: Pinned author-attested software-model corpus and original deterministic software guest; not hardware evidence.

build.recipe: Per ROM, from fixtures[].recipe: rgbasm -I fixtures/cgb-speed/ [-D name]... -o <work>/<rom>.o fixtures/cgb-speed/<source> && rgblink -o <work>/<rom> <work>/<rom>.o && rgbfix <rgbfix_flags> <work>/<rom>; every tool comes from the digest-pinned RGBDS v1.0.1 release archive.
build.committed_bytes_toolchain: RGBDS v1.0.1 macOS release archive (digest above); committed ROM is fixed with the manifest recipe.

profile.name: CGB-CPU-E
profile.applicability: Original software fixture for the deterministic bootless CGB-CPU-E profile in CGB mode; not physical-hardware evidence.

protocol.sample_layout: Four phase-major 32-byte records begin at WRAM $C100; the host reads them through gbb_peek_ram after the done marker at $C0FE.
protocol.tima: TAC selects 16 T-cycles; the unsigned counter delta between two adjacent LY transitions is stored at record offset 3. The derived interval includes the seven-M-cycle LY polling loop's maximum read-phase jitter.
protocol.key1: Offsets 0, 1, and 2 hold the phase readback, armed readback, and readback after STOP respectively.
protocol.stop_lines: LY is sampled directly before STOP and immediately after resume at offsets 13 and 15; the difference is interpreted modulo 154 lines.
protocol.div: DIV is read at two adjacent LY transitions after reset; its byte delta is stored at offset 4.
protocol.serial: SB is written with $A5 and SC starts an internal 512-T-cycle bit clock; D counts LY transitions through 8-bit completion, SC is stored at offset 6, and IF bit 3 is stored as a boolean at offset 7.
protocol.nr52_length: Channel 1 is power-cycled, triggered with length 1 and length enabled, then NR52 bit 0 is sampled once per LY until expiry; offsets 8-10 store start, elapsed lines, and end.
protocol.oam_dma: At the start of VBlank, two HRAM-only routines trigger DMA from C000 and perform CPU OAM reads at the bus phases 159 and 161 M-cycles after the FF46 write; this avoids PPU mode-2/3 OAM arbitration. Offsets 11 and 12 capture the returned data values.

scope_limits: This is a deterministic emulator-software probe, not physical hardware evidence.
Timing bounds are independently derived from documented clock units and the confirmed 12-09 stall value; they are not fitted to this core's observations.
The host driver uses only public API calls and fixed WRAM observations.
